The '''''Dark Vendetta''''' was a [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] in operation around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Used by the [[Tarnished Blades|Silent Blades]], the ship fought in and survived the [[Battle of the Silent Blades]], along with two [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]].
